surface_fix.what: ops/rehearse-chain.ps1 rehearses one commit in a standalone scratch clone seeded with the real out/ and db/, and records its verdict per content key
surface_fix.exact_change: clone --shared --no-checkout into %TEMP%\tc-rh-<id>\<arm>, push URL set to a path that does not exist, ops/seed-worktree.ps1 -Target <clone> -Source <main checkout>, refuse (blind=credential-present) a seed carrying google-oauth-client.json, google-oauth-token.json or meal-prep/.ghostkey, run the tree's own check-ad-cycles -SelfTest and refuse (blind=nopublish-unproven) unless its -NoPublish case passes by name, run check-ad-cycles -NoPull -NoCommit -NoPublish -NoAlert -ShipOnly (new: stops at the ship boundary, refused without -NoCommit, required by name like the -NoPublish case; -Full runs the whole chain) in a child with a sentinel GHOST_ADMIN_KEY, sentinel Kroger credentials, TC_REHEARSAL=1 and no GIT_* variable, read grocery/out/chain-verdict.json written by this run, then stage lib/bot-paths.ps1's owned paths under a private index and commit as smp-pipeline-bot through the tree's own ops/hooks/pre-commit installed into the clone's own .git/hooks. Stages chain, guards, commit. Exit 0 pass, 1 fail, 3 blind=<cause>. A failure is paired against the merge-base with origin/main over a freshly seeded arm: a stage failing on the base too is PREEXISTING and does not refuse. Verdict JSON at %LOCALAPPDATA%\ThriftyCrew\chain-rehearsal\<key>.json, key = SHA-256 of the manifest set's path+blob lines; the run root is removed in finally and a leftover is printed

items.root_cause: the estate proves a change against fixtures at push and against reality the next morning, by a different actor (the bot); a fixture cannot contain yesterday's empty cost-flags.txt or yesterday's board, so a change whose inputs are the pipeline's own outputs met them for the first time in production (F2). And the one switch that would have let anyone rehearse safely, -NoPublish, did not mean what it said

root_fix.what: a push to main that changes a chain-manifest script carries a recorded rehearsal pass over data at most 2 days old, or pre-push refuses it; the rehearsal runs outside the push lock
root_fix.exact_change: pre-push: after the test-auditors leg and BEFORE take_push_lock, `rehearse-chain.ps1 -CheckPush -RefsFromStdin` decides from the record in seconds (exit 1 no-verdict / rehearsed-fail / stale, exit 3 could-not-rehearse with its blind= cause, an exit 0 without the CHAIN-REHEARSAL-CHECK-COMPLETE marker is refused); TC_NO_REHEARSAL=<reason> is the loud bypass, printed and appended to bypass-log.jsonl beside the verdicts; a checkout with no rehearse-chain.ps1 says so and is not asked (the hold-push-lock older-checkout rule). push-main: after its gate and before Enter-TcPushLock, `rehearse-chain.ps1 -ForPush` rehearses HEAD when the push touches the manifest and no usable verdict exists, then refuses 1 or 3 before the queue; -NoRehearsal [-NoRehearsalReason] sets TC_NO_REHEARSAL. check-ad-cycles: the seven reader-facing writers now sit under -NoPublish, fixtured by the AST case 'MUST FIRE  every reader-facing writer is reached only without -NoPublish', which the harness requires by name before starting a tree. Manifest: files, globs, every .ps1 named by guards/compare-deals/capture-run, minus exclude_globs (tests, run-gates, prepush-*, the store pulls)

prevention.what: the push path itself carries the chain's first real run, instead of the 07:00 bot
prevention.exact_change: as root_fix; installed at landing by ops/install-hooks.ps1, never from this worktree

items.leaves_open: (1) a failure that needs TODAY's data (a store rendering first seen the same morning, like Sam's on 09-21, e291a1) is still first met in production: 1 of the 8. (2) Stages behind -NoPull (the store pulls, now excluded from the manifest) and behind -NoPublish (publish-deals-page, the recipe republish, hub, member mail) are never rehearsed, by design. (3) capture-run's commit-size gate is not rehearsed; only the pre-commit hook judges the staged set. (4) The cost: see resolution_note; measured over origin/main 2026-09-19 to 2026-09-22, 58 of 193 non-bot commits touched the manifest set (about 14 a day; pushes batch commits, so fewer rehearsals than that). (5) Concurrency is capped at 6 (Brad, 2026-09-22); the cap bounds count, not load, and the per-rehearsal peak (3.43 GB) was measured once, over one day's data. (6) Landed; the hook is installed from the main checkout at landing.
